description: Measured 2026-09-14 on interp and run (JIT): a dispatch-pure guard helper 'defp int?(_n :: integer), do: true' used as 'def g(x) when int?(x)' answers :matched for g(:a). The annotated parameter is named with a leading underscore, and its type does not become a plan precondition, so the helper admits every value. Repro: scratchpad/8b/t_typed.fz from the 8b research (session scratchpad; recreate from this description). Blocks nothing in fz-21x directly, but it is a miscompile in the guard-inlining path that 8b rewrites; fix or fold it into 8b.1 rather than carry it.
title: Guard helper with a wildcard-named annotated parameter loses its type precondition
